problems.problem: Exactness: the revision reads ‘His promise to be their God as binding His name to them’, but the only plural in the sentence before it is ‘nations’ (the plain sense ends ‘promises him nations and land’), so ‘their’ and ‘them’ attach to the nations, whereas Sforno’s ליחד שמי עליכם, on the lemma להיות לך לאלהים ולזרעך אחריך, is addressed to Abraham and his seed (יהיו הוא וזרעו נצחיים). The refuter (revrefute d001) noted the same ambiguity; a reader at six in the morning cannot tell who is bound.
problems.fix: Name the parties and drop the plural that misleads: ‘In Genesis 17 God appears to Abram and renames him Abraham; Sforno, on Genesis 17:7, reads His promise to be God to Abraham and his seed as binding His name to them without intermediary, so that, keeping the covenant, they endure for ever.’ (42 words; entry-check ok, tested in scratch/crit2-1fix.json).
